messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] canary us-west-2: p99 latency jump -> 620ms (+360% vs baseline). KernelFallback count spiked from 2 -> 42 in last 5m. batching.redispatch errors rising. link: https://ops.redwood/reports/8141592653

dmitri_oncall: acked, paging SRE + runtime. allocating on-call. investigating customer impact.

sean_runtime: saw the canary trace — KV cache misses + redispatch loop after the new batching optimizer landed in canary. suspect changeet: `deploy/2026-03-17/optimizer-batching-v2`

lina_sre: on it. starting live triage. are we seeing error spikes or just latency?

carlos_eng: errors are mostly 5xx from runtime ephemeral: `ERR_DISPATCH_TIMEOUT` and `KV_EVICT`. throughput backpressure observed (QPS down ~28%).

emma_support: any estimate on customer impact? a handful of top-tier customers reported slow responses in last 10m. CS queue rising.

platform-oncall: on-call takeover in 2 mins — dmitri please handoff when you have a summary.

sean_runtime: quick repro from canary logs:
```
2026-03-17T12:34:01Z INFO model=infer batch_id=987 redispatch=1 kv_miss=true latency_ms=512 kernel=scalar_fallback
2026-03-17T12:34:02Z WARN dispatch attempt=3 queue_wait_ms=1200
```
Seems the optimizer changes increase slice fanout, causing prefetch thrash and eviction -> more redispatch.

dmitri_oncall: summary for handoff: recent deploy `optimizer-batching-v2` -> increased fanout + smaller slices. Consequence: prefetch/kvcache thrash -> kernel selector falling back -> p99 latency spike. Customer visible slow responses (multiple enterprise customers). Action plan coming.

lina_sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag `batching.optimizer.v2` off for canary/gradual; 2) force kernel affinity to previous selector; 3) rollback deploy.

carlos_eng: can try (1) first since it should be quick. curl to toggler: `POST /ff/toggle batching.optimizer.v2?env=canary&state=off`

sean_runtime: also recommend disabling redispatch retries to stop storming: `redispatch.max_retries=0` on canary.

platform-oncall: I'm ready to execute flag flip + redispatch override. coordinating now.

platform-oncall: /ff toggle batching.optimizer.v2 off (canary) — executing.

incident-bot: Feature flag change recorded by platform-oncall at 8141592805: batching.optimizer.v2 -> OFF (canary).

sean_runtime: applied redispatch override: `redispatch.max_retries=0` at 8141592810.

lina_sre: monitoring metrics... p99 falling: 620 -> 340ms in 60s, kernel fallback events down. KV miss rate trending down.

emma_support: told CS to notify affected customers: "We've identified a canary rollout issue affecting latency; mitigation in progress; no broad customer rollback needed at this time."

dmitri_oncall: moving to staged traffic to ensure stability. If stable for 15m we keep changes; if reappears we'll rollback the deploy entirely.

carlos_eng: note: telemetry shows some sustained throttling on a small subset of slices even after FF flip — might need full rollback if not healed.

lina_sre: 10m check: p99 ~ 220-260ms, throughput recovering. no new 5xx spikes. marking as degraded -> mitigated.

platform-oncall: will coordinate with releases team to stop the global promotion of the optimizer. file: https://deploys.redwood/optimizer-batching-v2/status — paused.

sean_runtime: logging the quick commands used:
- `POST /ff/toggle batching.optimizer.v2?env=canary&state=off`
- `POST /runtime/config redispatch.max_retries=0 --target=canary`

dmitri_oncall: handoff complete — on-call remains dmitri for next 30m. SRE/Runtime to monitor. Customer impact: limited to canary and a few customers routed through canary infra; no widespread outage.

emma_support: CS update ready to send: "Issue identified in new batching optimizer; we mitigated by disabling the feature in canary and reducing retries; performance recovering. We'll update if we rollback the deployment."

carlos_eng: follow-up: create a follow-up CI test to simulate high-fanout prefetch with limited KV capacity. Also add a perf regression gate for `redispatch` counts.

lina_sre: agreed. I'll open an incident ticket and assign to runtime + releases for root cause and next steps.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-814159 (canary-batching-redispatch). Severity: SEV2. Escalation policy applied.

dmitri_oncall: closing this thread for now. re-open if signs reappear. :white_check_mark:
